summary: Iter189r follow-up retest — TDZ fix on /app/frontend/app/workout/[id]/guided.tsx is VERIFIED. The hoist of `currentEx`, `isCardio`, `targetSets`, `targetReps`, `restSec`, `workSec` from ~L346 up to L250 (BEFORE the `openHowTo` useCallback at L257) resolves the 'Cannot access currentEx before initialization' TDZ that crashed the screen in iter121. Full retest passed end-to-end on client@crewfit.com / today's workout 'Home Strength — Full Body' (id e0e25bc8-f00a-465a-80e4-5c012649e39c). GUIDED mode: screen mounts cleanly, mode picker shows (`gf-mode-log`, `gf-mode-autopilot`), selecting `gf-mode-log` advances to WARM-UP → tapping `gf-warmup-skip` reveals the work UI with the `gf-swap` bottom-bar button. SWAP flow: `gf-swap` opens the sheet showing all 3 legacy alternatives (`swap-btn-0/1/2`) with EQUIPMENT SWAP / EASIER REGRESSION / INJURY-FRIENDLY labels. Tapping `swap-btn-0` (Rear Foot Elevated Split Squat) successfully swapped 'Bulgarian Split Squat' → 'Rear Foot Elevated Split Squat (Bench)' — sheet closed, no error alert, no crash, and the WORK header + tile name + NEXT UP block all updated to the new exercise (proves reloadWorkout() re-hydration ran). AUTOPILOT mode: also loads cleanly (no TDZ), lands on the warm-up with NEXT UP correctly pointing at the newly swapped 'Rear Foot Elevated Split Squat (Bench) Set 1'. Both legs verified — retest complete.
